email.body1:
Max, saw Rilla launched The Rilla Masters program and is hiring across 17 roles into the new year.

Scaling that fast usually widens the gap between the signals hitting your stack and the team actually acting on them, so good accounts cool off before anyone reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, turning signal into booked meetings: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Rilla off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Max, quick follow-up for Rilla.

As ops, you feel signal-to-action latency more than anyone: leads land, but research, writing, and CRM logging slow the response and the lift never quite shows up in the numbers. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of Rilla's current outbound and three things I would change, then show how the measurable lift maps to your funnel. A quick call is all it takes.
email.body3:
Max, last bit of proof for Rilla.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. With our AI SDR they reached $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rilla's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Max, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know that scaling the team and the program at once is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I will tailor it to Rilla either way.
